name: Lower Bolinger
description: This keyword returns the Lower Bollinger value of any period of any series of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the Lower Bollinger value of any period of any series of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632222441.png)

You can plot Lower Bollinger on any series, like close in the above example, you can also plot Lower Bollinger of RSI, OPEN etc

Bollinger Bands are envelopes plotted at a standard deviation level above and below a simple moving average of the price.

Read more about Bollinger Bands here -  https://www.fidelity.com/learning-center/trading-investing/technical-analysis/technical-indicator-guide/bollinger-bands
